title: The Urchin's universal Time AI: one UrchinAutopilotConfig for Skein I1-I4 - on the what-if Skein (Regatta aim + rail seek), with the roll-decoupled AI nose lead (2.5 / 40)
goal: The roll-decoupled lead (brief 22, 2026-11-07): AIPilot flies NO roll stick while the nose lead steers (NoseLeadSteering.RollStick; ai_nose_lead roll law "zero", the default since this change), because the roll about the nose's forward corkscrewed every dual-stick hull at 2.5 (PRs #1829, #1831). Run by hand, two restarts (labels B, C); MODEL only; nothing promoted, the switch stays 0. Its twin: skein-urchin-time-lead. The lead-on twin of skein-urchin-time: the same search, the same seeds and genomes, with the pilot-side AI nose lead switched on in the model (nose_rate 1.5, nose_lead 2.5; Tools/Build/ai_nose_lead.py, the model of AIPilot.NoseLeadGain from PR #1786, which the game ships at 0). the Skein model already flies the fleet nose lag (nose_rate None = 1.5/s, skein_urchin_sim), so the parent's numbers are the lag-only cell; the twin states the rate explicitly and adds the lead. Garrett's plan (REGATTA_BALANCE_PLAN.md, the direction since 2026-11-06) judges every hull and every course on AIs that do not overshoot ring mouths, so each hull's drive is searched again with the lead on and compared with its lead-off twin on the same courses: the lead-on winner is the drive proposed for the day Yash turns the switch on. Run by hand until Compute is back (Shombith paused it 2026-11-06): /mnt/project-files/regatta-training/local_run.py, two independent restarts (labels B, C). Parent goal: The Urchin's universal Time AI (Docs/AI_SYSTEM/AI_PLAN.md step time-arcade): ONE UrchinAutopilotConfigSO (the rail decisions: ride, reverse, slip, launch, re-latch, Track) that races all four Skein intensities well, grown from the shipped genome. Raced on the Skein simulator (Tools/Build/skein_urchin_sim.py, a MODEL: the shipped cable exported from SkeinCourse.cs, the gate aim and rail lead, AIPilot, the ride and latch, the Track Projector, UrchinAutopilotDriver line for line); the loss is the four intensities together (mean + 0.5 x the worst). PROPOSED and RUN BY HAND while Froglet Compute is paused (Shombith, 2026-11-06): local_run.py restarts in a cloud container, results in Docs/Reports/SKEIN_URCHIN_AI.md. The genome is shared with Regatta and Hijack (no per-mode asset), so a winner is re-raced in Regatta's model before it is proposed.
asked_by: Garrett 2026-11-06 (Regatta balancing plan rev 2: train the AIs first); Yash owns the vessel AI.
area_owner: Yash (vessel AI, the Urchin's autopilot and Skein's AI)
promote: Only after Yash turns AIPilot.NoseLeadGain on (PR #1786) and its editor check passes; then as the parent's rule, against the parent's winner raced WITH the lead: A PROPOSAL for the AI owner (Yash), any of the core four approving: race the winner against the shipped genome on Skein's shipped cables and the two hold-out cables per intensity (holdout 2) from every slot; keep it only if it finishes at least as many races on every intensity and its composite is lower; then re-race it in Regatta's model (UrchinAutopilotConfig is shared with Regatta and Hijack). Written into Assets/Resources/UrchinAutopilotConfig.asset by a writer (the AI learning sweep's asset writer), never by hand. The editor check goes in Docs/UNITY_VERIFICATION_CHECKLIST.md (AI Urchins race Skein at I1-I4).
